inputs.prompt: Create a completely new original xianxia character portrait on image 1, keeping its vertical 2:3 canvas and flat solid magenta #FF00FF background. Image 2 is ONLY a painting-style reference: use confident black ink brush strokes, dry-brush texture, flowing sleeve and sash shapes, white and grey cloth and deep black accents. Do not copy the character, pose, clothing design, pixels, UI or background from image 2. Subject: an original dignified Chinese male sect master in his late thirties, calm expression, long black hair tied high with a small jade hairpin, an original white robe with black waist sash, exactly one small jade green accent color. Soft semi-realistic manga face. Three-quarter-length standing portrait, cropped at mid-thigh above the knees, relaxed original pose with body slightly angled, centered figure, head center at 50 percent from the left and 31.7708 percent from the top; generous empty margins left and right. Only one character. Flat solid magenta #FF00FF background, no shadow, no gradient, no floor, no ink splashes outside the figure. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or UI.
inputs.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, typography, logo, watermark, signature, frame, UI, interface, buttons, multiple characters, copied pose, copied costume, cast shadow, ground, floor, gradient background, grey background, scenery, ink splashes outside the figure, full-length legs, feet
